fieldIdentityStatus: semantic review identifiers; public option names remain gated by the configuration-language and naming ADRs

fields.portableMeaning: Selects exactly one descriptively named pinned profile and records explicit or implicit selection as non-semantic explanation metadata.
fields.valueShape: Profile name plus normalized selection-origin enum.
fields.omissionSemantics: Select workspace-edit-offline and materialize that choice visibly.
fields.manifestProjection: Name, pinned source identity, version, and digest in the semantic domain; non-hashed selection origin in the explanation domain.
fields.rationale: Profile selection changes normalized semantics and must never be delegated to a target or backend default.

fields.portableMeaning: Materializes the complete profile contribution before explicit-field composition and final validation.
fields.valueShape: Fully expanded portable Artifact fragment with field-level origins.
fields.omissionSemantics: No field may remain unresolved or fall through to a target default.
fields.manifestProjection: Complete expansion and non-hashed explanation provenance.
fields.rationale: Target construction consumes only expanded semantics; Packet D later proves every composition path reaches this state.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires imports, profile expansion, explicit fields, overrides, native handles, and raw canonical input to converge on the same final Artifact validator.
fields.valueShape: Cross-cutting construction-path coverage relation over the fully expanded Artifact.
fields.omissionSemantics: No supported composition or escape path is exempt from final validation.
forbiddenInputs: Override or native path that bypasses the canonical Artifact boundary.
fields.manifestProjection: Final expanded semantics plus non-hashed contributing-source provenance.
fields.rationale: Packet B defines the final field semantics; Packet D proves every ordinary and strongest construction path reaches them.

fields.portableMeaning: Carries immutable descriptive name, description, and string labels with no control semantics.
fields.valueShape: Optional name and description plus a closed string map.
fields.omissionSemantics: No author-supplied descriptive metadata.
forbiddenInputs: Placement, credential, lifecycle, or policy selectors.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical descriptive metadata map.
fields.rationale: Metadata remains safely extensible only while consumers are forbidden from interpreting it as another resource.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares workload OS, architecture, and Nix target-system contract.
fields.valueShape: Closed OS, architecture, and target-system tuple with namespaced extension support.
fields.omissionSemantics: Invalid; the platform must be explicit before construction.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved workload platform tuple.
fields.rationale: Workload platform affects package resolution and every target member, while current host capability belongs to preflight.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares ordered typed pinned package references and their closures for the workload platform.
fields.valueShape: List of typed Nix input, attribute, output, and target-system references.
fields.omissionSemantics: No packages beyond other explicit environment components.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved package and closure identities in canonical order.
fields.rationale: Package intent is immutable Artifact content; actual realization and target closure checks continue in Packet C.

fields.portableMeaning: Imports one typed pinned devShell through a closed lossless projection.
fields.valueShape: Typed Nix input, devShell attribute, output system, and importer-version reference.
fields.omissionSemantics: No devShell contribution.
forbiddenInputs: Silent dropping of unsupported shell state.
fields.manifestProjection: Importer version, source identity, retained categories, and resolved content identities.
fields.rationale: A devShell is a development/build environment importer, not a root filesystem or opaque activation mechanism.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares explicit non-secret process environment defaults.
fields.valueShape: Closed string-keyed map of non-secret values with reserved-name validation.
fields.omissionSemantics: No variable is inherited or synthesized.
forbiddenInputs: Ambient caller, daemon, builder, or host variables.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical non-secret environment map with redaction classification.
fields.rationale: Environment defaults affect deterministic behavior and cannot inherit mutable ambient state.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares the complete ordered executable search path derived from Artifact content.
fields.valueShape: Ordered list of in-Artifact executable directories.
fields.omissionSemantics: No host PATH or backend image PATH is inherited.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical ordered search path.
fields.rationale: Path order is observable process semantics and therefore explicit and target-invariant.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares an ordered sequence of trusted argv-form activation commands.
fields.valueShape: List of non-empty argv arrays with explicit order.
fields.omissionSemantics: No activation runs.
fields.manifestProjection: Ordered activation argv metadata and executable identities.
fields.rationale: Explicit argv preserves portable execution semantics without shell interpolation.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires omission to remain absence and forbids ambient environment inheritance.
fields.valueShape: Derived closed-environment requirement.
fields.omissionSemantics: The requirement is always active.
forbiddenInputs: Backend-specific inheritance allowlists in Artifact source.
fields.manifestProjection: Closed-environment requirement and reserved-name policy version.
fields.rationale: Packet B fixes static semantics; Packet F verifies runtime descriptors, environment, logs, and disclosure cannot bypass them.

fields.portableMeaning: Optionally declares the default Process executable and arguments in argv form.
fields.valueShape: Absent or one non-empty argv array.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact-default Process command and no image/backend entrypoint inheritance.
fields.manifestProjection: Explicit argv or explicit absence.
fields.rationale: Artifact defaults and runtime Process requests share semantics without making an omitted default auto-start anything.

fields.portableMeaning: Optionally declares a default absolute working directory inside the permitted Sandbox filesystem.
fields.valueShape: Absent or normalized absolute in-sandbox path.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact cwd default; a complete runtime Process must choose one.
forbiddenInputs: Current-host, provider, builder, or driver paths.
fields.manifestProjection: Explicit cwd or explicit absence.
fields.rationale: The default Process cannot escape or reinterpret the Artifact filesystem namespace.

fields.portableMeaning: Optionally narrows or supplements ordinary non-secret Process environment within the Artifact environment contract.
fields.valueShape: Closed non-secret string map with reserved-name validation.
fields.omissionSemantics: Use only the Artifact environment map.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical default Process environment delta.
fields.rationale: Process defaults may specialize ordinary environment but cannot create a secret side channel.

fields.portableMeaning: Optionally selects one workload-visible identity already permitted by the Artifact identity contract.
fields.valueShape: Absent or typed workload user/group reference.
fields.omissionSemantics: Use the Artifact's selected workload identity.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved workload identity reference.
fields.rationale: The default Process can preserve or narrow identity but never select host privilege.

fields.portableMeaning: Makes absence of every default Process member an explicit portable semantic.
fields.valueShape: Presence bitmap over the default Process record.
fields.omissionSemantics: Absent remains absent on every target.
forbiddenInputs: OCI image or provider fallback defaults.
Any sentinel or value requesting backend-default inheritance.
fields.manifestProjection: Explicit presence/absence for all default Process members.
fields.rationale: XRS-014 rejects inheritance requests in the normalized Artifact; MAN-004 and Packet C prove every lowerer suppresses target-native defaults when fields are absent.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares the logical workspace binding interface without a concrete source.
fields.valueShape: One typed slot with identity, cardinality, source-kind constraints, and workspace contract digest.
fields.omissionSemantics: No workspace binding interface unless supplied by the selected visible profile.
fields.manifestProjection: Complete workspace slot contract.
fields.rationale: Artifact declares the interface; Create supplies the concrete source and compatible materialization.

fields.portableMeaning: Names the absolute project root visible inside the Sandbox.
fields.valueShape: Normalized absolute in-sandbox path.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile supplies /workspace; otherwise a declared workspace requires an explicit destination.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized workspace destination.
fields.rationale: The destination is portable observable behavior independent of target mount mechanism.

fields.portableMeaning: Sets the workspace read-only or read-write authority ceiling.
fields.valueShape: Closed access enum.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile supplies read-write; otherwise a workspace declaration must be explicit.
fields.manifestProjection: Workspace access ceiling.
fields.rationale: Access is immutable policy; retention and result transfer remain separate runtime choices.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires one materialization or permits a non-empty set from which Create selects.
fields.valueShape: Mandatory alternative or non-empty set of permitted typed alternatives.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile declares its permitted materializations; no target chooses implicitly.
fields.manifestProjection: Mandatory or permitted materialization contracts per runtime profile.
fields.rationale: Artifact expresses reusable bounds while Create chooses a supported concrete binding.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares workload-visible ownership expectations for the workspace tree.
fields.valueShape: Workload UID/GID or named identity reference plus ownership behavior enum.
fields.omissionSemantics: Use the selected workload identity without importing a host mapping.
fields.manifestProjection: Workload ownership expectations.
fields.rationale: Observable in-sandbox ownership is portable; host/guest mapping and materialization strategy are realization details.

fields.portableMeaning: Determines whether a compatible workspace binding is required at creation.
fields.valueShape: Required or optional cardinality.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile makes the workspace required.
fields.manifestProjection: Workspace binding cardinality.
fields.rationale: The Artifact owns the interface cardinality; Create proves it supplies the required binding.

fields.portableMeaning: Narrows selected workspace subpaths to immutable read-only or masked protection modes.
fields.valueShape: List of root-relative normalized paths with closed protection mode.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile protects .git, .agents, and .codex; otherwise no additional protected subpaths.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical protected-path contracts.
fields.rationale: Static path policy is Artifact-owned; Packet F later covers symlink, hardlink, traversal, and disclosure enforcement.

fields.portableMeaning: Forbids synchronization, writeback, retention, capture, export, and snapshot timing from becoming workspace fields.
fields.valueShape: Closed workspace record with no lifecycle members.
fields.omissionSemantics: Runtime caller chooses among supported operations without changing Artifact identity.
fields.manifestProjection: Workspace contract only; no runtime operation choices.
fields.rationale: Packet E owns live retention and result-transfer operations and must preserve the Artifact workspace bounds.

fields.portableMeaning: Adds typed pinned read-only content at explicit in-sandbox destinations.
fields.valueShape: List of immutable-input identities, destinations, and content modes.
fields.omissionSemantics: No extra immutable inputs beyond the environment and target base.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved content identities, digests, destinations, and read-only contract.
fields.rationale: Immutable content participates in construction and identity and remains distinct from runtime-writable resources.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares logical mount interfaces and their maximum access without concrete sources.
fields.valueShape: List of typed slot identities, source-kind constraints, cardinality, destination, and access ceiling.
fields.omissionSemantics: No additional mount interfaces.
forbiddenInputs: Bind, share, overlay, block, or volume implementation choice.
fields.manifestProjection: Complete mount-slot contracts.
fields.rationale: Slots preserve one portable binding API while Packet C owns target-specific mount realization.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares private writable one-Sandbox scratch roots and references their mandatory hard capacity bounds.
fields.valueShape: List of destinations, medium classes, and capacity-bound identities under artifact.resources.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile supplies private home and temporary roots; otherwise no scratch.
fields.manifestProjection: Scratch destinations, medium requirements, and hard maxima.
fields.rationale: Scratch is ephemeral private state, not a generic persistence or volume abstraction.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares logical independent-lifecycle volume binding interfaces.
fields.valueShape: List of slot identities, destinations, access, cardinality, and capacity bounds.
fields.omissionSemantics: No persistent-volume binding interface.
forbiddenInputs: Provider, attachment, filesystem-driver, or retention choice.
fields.manifestProjection: Complete volume-slot contracts and bounds.
fields.rationale: Persistent storage is a runtime-bound resource whose reusable constraints belong to the Artifact.

fields.portableMeaning: Explicitly requires immutable root or a private writable root that references a mandatory capacity bound.
fields.valueShape: Closed immutable alternative or private writable alternative with a capacity-bound identity under artifact.resources.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile uses an immutable base plus declared writable roots; no backend writable layer is inferred.
fields.manifestProjection: Root mutability alternative, scope, and bounds.
fields.rationale: Root writability is observable security and storage policy, not an incidental image/runtime default.

fields.portableMeaning: Normalizes one conflict-free destination graph across workspace, immutable content, writable roots, secrets, and outputs.
fields.valueShape: Validated path graph with explicit permitted nested compositions.
fields.omissionSemantics: No undeclared target mount or shadowing relationship is permitted.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical resource roots, nesting relations, and protection constraints.
fields.rationale: Packets C and F must realize and probe the exact graph without target-specific shadowing or traversal bypass.

fields.portableMeaning: Selects no IP connectivity, unrestricted egress, or controlled egress as a closed authority alternative.
fields.valueShape: Closed access-mode enum.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile supplies no IP network access; no target network default applies.
forbiddenInputs: Host-network mode as a portable value.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved access mode and hard authority ceiling.
fields.rationale: Network authority is observable hard policy even though targets enforce it through different mechanisms.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares typed egress rules and the versioned enforcement capability required to implement them.
fields.valueShape: Normalized domain, CIDR, protocol, port, or broker rules with capability requirement.
fields.omissionSemantics: No egress rules; controlled mode without rules is invalid unless its closed semantics explicitly deny all.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical egress rules and enforcement requirement.
fields.rationale: Destination policy is portable intent only when the Artifact requires a conforming enforcement implementation.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares denied, policy-coupled, or explicitly permitted DNS behavior.
fields.valueShape: Closed DNS alternative with resolver and enforcement semantics when applicable.
fields.omissionSemantics: When IP access is none, omission normalizes to denied. Under unrestricted or controlled IP access, omission is invalid: DNS must explicitly be denied or declare a compatible resolver/enforcement contract. The normalized alternative is always recorded.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved DNS alternative and required enforcement capability.
fields.rationale: DNS can bypass destination policy and therefore cannot be an implicit consequence of target networking.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares logical inbound port interfaces and their protocol/guest-port bounds.
fields.valueShape: List of unique port-slot identities, protocol, guest port/range, and exposure ceiling.
fields.omissionSemantics: No inbound port interface.
forbiddenInputs: Public URL, domain, or provider endpoint.
fields.manifestProjection: Port-slot contracts and network-policy ceiling.
fields.rationale: Artifact declares reusable port interfaces; Create/live operations and operator infrastructure choose concrete exposure.

fields.portableMeaning: References declared secret slots needed by a network policy without embedding credential values or providers.
fields.valueShape: List of secret-slot identities and required audience.
fields.omissionSemantics: Network policy has no credential dependency.
fields.manifestProjection: Secret-slot identities and audience contracts only.
fields.rationale: Credential interfaces are declarative, while values and providers remain Create/operator-owned.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares each non-IP host communication interface independently.
fields.valueShape: List of typed socket, vsock, bus, display/audio, broker, or descriptor-slot contracts.
fields.omissionSemantics: No host communication channel; network mode does not imply one.
fields.manifestProjection: Typed host-channel contracts and required capabilities.
fields.rationale: No IP connectivity does not prove host isolation, so every other channel is explicit and separately bounded.

fields.portableMeaning: Bounds simultaneously runnable workload CPU concurrency.
fields.valueShape: Positive integral minimum and optional hard maximum with workload/sandbox scope.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact concurrency bound.
forbiddenInputs: CPU quota or relative weight encoded as concurrency.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized concurrency range and enforcement scope.
fields.rationale: Concurrency is not interchangeable with rate or priority and must be named precisely.

fields.portableMeaning: Bounds absolute CPU quota separately from optional relative scheduling weight.
fields.valueShape: Unit-explicit quota/period range and a separately typed relative-weight constraint.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact CPU rate or weight bound.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized quota and relative-weight constraints with scopes.
fields.rationale: Kernel and provider controls distinguish absolute limits from relative weights.

fields.portableMeaning: Bounds total Sandbox or VMM memory including runtime/guest overhead.
fields.valueShape: Unit-explicit minimum and optional hard maximum with total-sandbox scope.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact total-memory bound.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized total-memory range and scope.
fields.rationale: A VM's assigned RAM and a process/container workload ceiling have different observable scopes.

fields.portableMeaning: Optionally bounds workload memory independently from total Sandbox overhead.
fields.valueShape: Unit-explicit minimum and optional hard maximum with workload scope.
fields.omissionSemantics: No separate workload-memory bound.
forbiddenInputs: Assuming a total VM allocation proves workload enforcement.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized workload-memory range and enforcement requirement.
fields.rationale: Separate scope prevents a host cgroup or guest allocation from being misrepresented as a workload limit.

fields.portableMeaning: Explicitly denies swap or bounds swap in a named enforcement scope.
fields.valueShape: Closed denied alternative or unit-explicit bounded alternative.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact swap claim; a target cannot advertise swap semantics unless otherwise required.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved swap alternative and enforcement scope.
fields.rationale: Swap changes memory behavior and must not be silently folded into a memory number.

fields.portableMeaning: Bounds workload tasks/threads using an explicitly named counting model.
fields.valueShape: Positive integral minimum and optional hard maximum plus task-count semantic version.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact task ceiling.
forbiddenInputs: Ambiguous process count when the mechanism counts threads.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized task bound and counting semantics.
fields.rationale: Linux pids controllers count tasks/TIDs, which is not necessarily an application's process count.

fields.portableMeaning: Bounds the private writable root layer separately from volumes and tmpfs.
fields.valueShape: Unit-explicit capacity minimum and optional hard maximum.
fields.omissionSemantics: No writable root when filesystem policy is immutable; invalid if a private writable root exists without this bound.
fields.manifestProjection: Writable-root capacity range and scope.
fields.rationale: Writable root, independent volume, and memory-backed tmpfs consume different resources.

fields.portableMeaning: Sets capacity ranges per logical persistent-volume slot.
fields.valueShape: Map from volume-slot identity to unit-explicit range.
fields.omissionSemantics: The slot has no Artifact capacity requirement.
fields.manifestProjection: Per-slot normalized capacity bounds.
fields.rationale: Artifact constraints attach to logical slots; actual storage allocation is selected at Create/operator admission.

fields.portableMeaning: Sets capacity ranges per memory-backed scratch/tmpfs root.
fields.valueShape: Map from scratch identity to unit-explicit range.
fields.omissionSemantics: No tmpfs bound when no tmpfs scratch exists; invalid if a tmpfs scratch root exists without its bound.
forbiddenInputs: Treating tmpfs capacity as independent disk.
fields.manifestProjection: Per-scratch normalized tmpfs bounds.
fields.rationale: Memory-backed storage participates in both filesystem and memory planning and therefore needs explicit scope.

fields.portableMeaning: Optionally bounds directional byte rate or operation rate for a named storage resource.
fields.valueShape: List of resource identity, read/write direction, bytes-per-second or IOPS dimension, minimum, and hard maximum.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact I/O performance bound.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized per-resource directional I/O constraints.
fields.rationale: Bandwidth and IOPS are different dimensions and target support is capability-gated.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares the workload-visible user by numeric identity or a name resolved from constructed content.
fields.valueShape: Canonical UID/GID or typed name reference with resolution source.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile supplies an unprivileged sandbox user.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved workload UID/GID and optional canonical name.
fields.rationale: Workload identity must be deterministic without equating guest/container root to host root.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares the complete explicit workload supplementary-group set.
fields.valueShape: Canonical unique GIDs or typed names resolved from constructed content.
fields.omissionSemantics: No supplementary groups.
forbiddenInputs: Device-injected groups not projected through policy.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved complete supplementary-group set.
fields.rationale: Ambient groups can grant filesystem or device authority and cannot be inherited implicitly.

fields.portableMeaning: Separates workload-visible identity from concrete host/guest mappings and launcher privilege.
fields.valueShape: Derived prohibition with target mapping requirements.
fields.omissionSemantics: Concrete mapping remains a validated realization decision.
fields.manifestProjection: Workload identity plus required mapping capability, never a live mapping.
fields.rationale: Packet C lowers portable identity into target-specific mappings without changing what the workload observes.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires or explicitly permits privilege transitions under a closed privilege contract.
fields.valueShape: Closed required/compatible enum rather than a backend boolean.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile requires no-new-privileges.
fields.manifestProjection: Privilege-transition requirement and conformance identity.
fields.rationale: No-new-privileges interacts with executable/file capabilities and must be validated as part of one ceiling.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares the complete permitted Linux capability ceiling and relationships among capability sets.
fields.valueShape: Canonical unique bounding, permitted, effective, inheritable, and ambient set constraints.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile permits no Linux capabilities.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical capability ceiling and semantic version.
fields.rationale: A single capability list loses important privilege relationships; the Artifact owns the full ceiling.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires versioned semantic syscall, filesystem, namespace, or other kernel-surface restrictions without conflating mechanisms.
fields.valueShape: List of registered/namespaced policy contract identities, versions, architecture applicability, and strength.
fields.omissionSemantics: Only the selected profile's explicit security requirements apply; no mechanism default is claimed.
forbiddenInputs: Opaque unversioned blobs as complete policy.
Claim that seccomp alone is a sandbox.
fields.manifestProjection: Policy requirement identities, versions, scope, and required conformance.
fields.rationale: Seccomp, LSM/Landlock, syd, namespaces, and VM isolation cover different security dimensions.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares logical device classes and explicitly projects every induced authority change.
fields.valueShape: List of class, count, access, isolation, capability, and projected edit contracts.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile receives only the documented minimal virtual/pseudo device set.
forbiddenInputs: Live device identity or host path.
fields.manifestProjection: Logical device requirements and projected policy edits.
fields.rationale: Concrete allocation is dynamic, while required device semantics and authority ceiling are immutable.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares the required root-filesystem writability and bound resource relationship.
fields.valueShape: Immutable alternative or bounded private writable-root reference.
fields.omissionSemantics: Selected profile's complete expansion is explicit; no target image/runtime default.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved root alternative and bound resource identity.
fields.rationale: Root writability is a security property as well as a storage resource.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares unique logical secret interfaces without values, providers, or lookup expressions.
fields.valueShape: List of unique slot identities, required/optional cardinality, and typed delivery alternatives.
fields.omissionSemantics: Artifact accepts no secret binding.
fields.manifestProjection: Value-free secret-slot identity and cardinality.
fields.rationale: The Artifact owns its secret interface while concrete references and values remain outside immutable inputs.

fields.portableMeaning: Permits a non-empty set of explicit file, credential, or environment delivery alternatives.
fields.valueShape: Closed alternative set with kind-specific required and forbidden members.
fields.omissionSemantics: Invalid for a declared secret slot.
fields.manifestProjection: Permitted ephemeral delivery alternatives and their constraints.
fields.rationale: Delivery forms have different leakage and ownership semantics and cannot be one generic value.

fields.portableMeaning: Names the typed ephemeral secret destination and prevents conflicts with ordinary resources.
fields.valueShape: File path, credential identity, or reserved environment name according to delivery kind.
fields.omissionSemantics: Invalid when the chosen delivery kind requires a destination.
fields.manifestProjection: Destination contract without any bound secret reference.
fields.rationale: Static destination conflicts can and must fail before any secret is bound.

fields.portableMeaning: Bounds secret audience, file ownership/mode, and maximum delivery lifetime per alternative.
fields.valueShape: Audience identifiers, kind-specific ownership/mode, and a required positive finite maximum delivery lifetime.
fields.omissionSemantics: A delivery alternative without a maximum delivery lifetime is invalid; only kind-inapplicable ownership or mode members may be absent.
fields.manifestProjection: Secret-safe audience and delivery constraint metadata.
fields.rationale: The reusable contract limits delivery, while Create chooses a concrete secret and lifetime inside it.

fields.portableMeaning: Explicitly forbids or permits inclusion for every snapshot class capable of capturing the delivery surface.
fields.valueShape: Map from compatible snapshot class to forbidden/permitted treatment.
fields.omissionSemantics: Invalid when any required snapshot class can capture the secret surface.
fields.manifestProjection: Secret-safe compatibility matrix between slot and snapshot classes.
fields.rationale: Secret and snapshot contracts must agree before runtime; Packet F later verifies no disclosure.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares mandatory or optional versioned capability requirements and their dependency closure.
fields.valueShape: List of registered/namespaced identities, version constraints, strength, and dependency edges.
fields.omissionSemantics: No capability beyond explicit field semantics and selected profile requirements.
forbiddenInputs: Unregistered capability identity or unsatisfiable version constraint.
fields.manifestProjection: Normalized capability requirements; builder-produced support and conformance facts are separate manifest claims.
fields.rationale: Capabilities communicate optional/common-shaped semantics without pretending every target implements them.

fields.portableMeaning: Declares compatible target, driver, guest-runtime, evidence, and control protocol version requirements.
fields.valueShape: List of protocol identity and accepted version range.
fields.omissionSemantics: Only mandatory product baseline protocols apply and are materialized in the manifest.
fields.manifestProjection: Resolved supported protocol identities and versions.
fields.rationale: Packet C defines target/guest protocol lowering and loader compatibility without exposing operator endpoints.

fields.portableMeaning: States hard workspace access/materialization capabilities every usable target/profile combination must satisfy.
fields.valueShape: Mandatory semantics plus permitted selection matrix.
fields.omissionSemantics: Derived completely from the workspace contract.
fields.manifestProjection: Workspace capability requirements per supported runtime profile.
fields.rationale: Requirement projection lets target validation reject unsupported semantics before Create.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires each target to enforce every hard network, filesystem, resource, identity, security, and device semantic or reject the Artifact.
fields.valueShape: Derived list of semantic requirement identities and evidence classes.
fields.omissionSemantics: No hard field is treated as advisory.
fields.manifestProjection: Required enforcement and evidence contracts per target member/profile.
fields.rationale: Packet C proves target support and Packet F proves observed enforcement/disclosure at runtime.

fields.portableMeaning: Optionally sets a positive finite hard maximum lifetime for any Sandbox created from the Artifact.
fields.valueShape: Absent or unit-explicit positive finite duration.
fields.omissionSemantics: No Artifact-imposed lifetime ceiling; operator policy may still impose a narrower maximum.
fields.manifestProjection: Optional immutable lifetime ceiling and explicit absence.
fields.rationale: Packet B locks the hard security ceiling; Packet E owns Create selection, renewal, idle behavior, deadlines, and teardown.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires Create resolution, live lifecycle, and Process deadlines to preserve and enforce the immutable Artifact maximum-lifetime ceiling.
fields.valueShape: Cross-boundary relation from the optional Artifact ceiling to resolved expiration and remaining-lifetime checks.
fields.omissionSemantics: When the Artifact ceiling is absent, this relation introduces no Artifact-derived deadline; operator or Create limits remain independently valid.
forbiddenInputs: Runtime extension beyond the Artifact ceiling.
Treating an absent Artifact ceiling as a target default.
fields.manifestProjection: Immutable ceiling or explicit absence for Packet E resolution and enforcement.
fields.rationale: Packet B validates the static ceiling at A1; Packet E proves that creation, renewal, idle handling, Process deadlines, and teardown preserve it at runtime.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires a structured snapshot capability class and hard capture compatibility, not one runtime snapshot operation.
fields.valueShape: Component set, external-storage/secret/device-state treatment, compatibility domain, and quiescing requirement.
fields.omissionSemantics: Artifact does not require snapshot support.
forbiddenInputs: Snapshot timing, destination, retention, or provider ID.
fields.manifestProjection: Complete snapshot capability requirement and compatible runtime profiles.
fields.rationale: Packet E defines request/restore lifecycle while the Artifact constrains which implementations are usable.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires versioned support for optional pause/resume, fork, resize, checkpoint, PTY, or other lifecycle capabilities.
fields.valueShape: List of capability requirements without operation timing or parameters.
fields.omissionSemantics: No optional lifecycle capability is required by the Artifact.
forbiddenInputs: One run's pause, fork, resize, or checkpoint request.
fields.manifestProjection: Required optional-operation capabilities and conformance versions.
fields.rationale: Artifact requirements preserve portability; Packet E owns actual operations and state-dependent validation.

fields.portableMeaning: Publishes exact file or directory result conventions eligible for later runtime collection.
fields.valueShape: List of unique identity, exact normalized path, and file/directory kind.
fields.omissionSemantics: No declared output convention beyond standard Process termination data.
forbiddenInputs: Capture timing, selection, retention, or required-existence policy.
fields.manifestProjection: Canonical output identity, path, and kind.
fields.rationale: Exact typed paths permit static compatibility checks while runtime caller retains collection choices.

fields.portableMeaning: Proves each output is reachable through a writable permitted path without crossing a secret/protected/immutable boundary.
fields.valueShape: Validated relation between output and filesystem path graph.
fields.omissionSemantics: No output compatibility relation when no outputs exist.
fields.manifestProjection: Output-to-filesystem resource relationship and protection constraints.
fields.rationale: Static path compatibility is known at Artifact validation; runtime traversal enforcement remains Packet F.

fields.portableMeaning: Separates eligibility from one operation's selection, strict capture, archive/patch format, export destination, timing, and retention.
fields.valueShape: Closed Artifact declarations consumed by typed runtime collection requests.
fields.omissionSemantics: Declaring an output neither selects it nor requires it to exist for every run.
fields.manifestProjection: Eligible output conventions only.
fields.rationale: Packet E owns collection operations; a selected strict collection succeeds completely or fails.

fields.portableMeaning: Requests versioned build-provenance schemes and minimum claim classes without authoring verified facts.
fields.valueShape: List of registered/namespaced scheme identities, versions, and required claim classes.
fields.omissionSemantics: Mandatory identity/content facts remain; no additional provenance scheme is required.
forbiddenInputs: Runtime execution evidence or retention policy.
fields.manifestProjection: Requested scheme plus builder-emitted facts with verification classification.
fields.rationale: Packet F separates author requirements, builder facts, verified claims, explanation data, and safe disclosure.

fields.portableMeaning: Records pinned profile semantic identity separately from non-hashed selection/explanation origins.
fields.valueShape: Pinned source, version, digest, expansion digest, and explanation-origin records.
fields.omissionSemantics: Profile provenance is always present because one profile is always selected.
forbiddenInputs: Checkout path or source span in semantic digest.
fields.manifestProjection: Hashed semantic profile identity plus non-hashed explanation provenance.
fields.rationale: Profile content changes identity, while author spelling and source locations must not.

fields.portableMeaning: Associates each byte-changing native handle with its target member without minting unearned conformance claims.
fields.valueShape: Typed native-handle identity, affected member relation, and claim classification.
fields.omissionSemantics: No native provenance when no native input affects the member.
fields.manifestProjection: Safe native identities, affected member, and granular conformance loss/verification.
fields.rationale: Packet D proves composition cannot bypass identity; Packet F defines safe claim and disclosure semantics.

fields.portableMeaning: Identifies one fully expanded validated portable Artifact semantic value.
fields.valueShape: Typed canonical semantic digest.
fields.omissionSemantics: Always generated after normalization and wire validation.
forbiddenInputs: Formatting, source spans, checkout path, timestamp, selection explicitness, or explanation provenance.
fields.manifestProjection: Typed portable semantic digest.
fields.rationale: Semantic identity is content-addressed portable meaning, not a deployment, runtime, or target-member identity.

fields.portableMeaning: Separates target-member content identities and Artifact Set identity from the portable semantic digest.
fields.valueShape: Typed member digests, member identities, and set identity with verified relations.
fields.omissionSemantics: Always generated for every constructed member and Artifact Set.
fields.manifestProjection: Typed identity domains and verified relationship graph.
fields.rationale: Packet C constructs members; Packet F governs verification evidence and safe disclosure.

fields.portableMeaning: Names a non-empty unique set of registered/namespaced target families that will produce Artifact Set members.
fields.valueShape: Non-empty set of target identities and target-construction contract versions.
fields.omissionSemantics: Invalid; no backend target is selected heuristically.
forbiddenInputs: Divergent common semantics inside one Artifact.
fields.manifestProjection: Enabled target identities and construction contract versions.
fields.rationale: Target families are explicit construction outputs; operator availability is evaluated only when a Sandbox is created.

fields.portableMeaning: Selects or requires explicit compatible runtime-profile identities for each enabled target without authoring a support or conformance claim.
fields.valueShape: Map from target to a non-empty set of registered profile identities and required capability/conformance-version constraints.
fields.omissionSemantics: Invalid for an enabled target that has no usable runtime profile.
fields.manifestProjection: Requested target/profile matrix and constraints; builders separately emit support facts and conformance evidence.
fields.rationale: Artifact declares which profiles its members must satisfy; member construction proves support, Create selects an advertised proven profile, and Operator maps it to infrastructure.

fields.portableMeaning: Requires every member of one Artifact Set to preserve identical common environment, workspace, policy, bounds, and requirements.
fields.valueShape: Common semantic digest shared by all member construction inputs.
fields.omissionSemantics: Always active; intentional divergence requires a separate named Artifact Definition.
fields.manifestProjection: Shared semantic identity and per-member conformance relationship.
fields.rationale: Separate named Artifacts are clearer and safer than pretending divergent members are equivalent.

fields.portableMeaning: Provides registered versioned Artifact-construction-only native configuration under an enabled target.
fields.valueShape: Map from enabled target and native namespace/version to typed pinned handles or target-local construction values.
fields.omissionSemantics: Target uses only product-owned construction from common semantics.
fields.manifestProjection: Safe namespace/version, resolved handle identities, affected member, and conformance classification.
fields.rationale: Packet D proves native composition and escape hatches cannot bypass common policy or identity.

fields.portableMeaning: Constructs one target member per distinct target-specific bytes and hard-requirements shape from identical common semantics; byte-identical compatible runtime profiles may share that member.
fields.valueShape: Generated typed target-construction input, built member relation, and one-or-more compatible runtime-profile associations.
fields.omissionSemantics: No enabled target/profile may silently disappear or downgrade; unsupported construction fails.
fields.manifestProjection: Target member identity, content digests, protocols, requirements, and exact common projection.
fields.rationale: Packet C owns lowerers and adapters while Packet B fixes every field they must preserve.

fields.portableMeaning: Groups the target members constructed from one common portable semantic Artifact identity.
fields.valueShape: Typed Artifact Set identity plus non-empty member map and shared semantic identity.
fields.omissionSemantics: Always generated after all requested target members build successfully.
fields.manifestProjection: Artifact Set identity, shared semantic identity, and complete member identity graph.
fields.rationale: The flake deterministically produces an Artifact Set; live Sandbox creation consumes one advertised member/profile.
